ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the circuit shown in figure, the switch is closed at time \( t=0 \). The steady state value of the voltage \( V_c \) is _____ V.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left side of the circuit is a 10 V DC voltage source, with the upper terminal as the positive terminal; above the source, it is connected through a switch that closes at t=0 to the top 1 mH inductor. On the right main branch, there is a 1 Ω resistor above, and there is also a 1 Ω resistor below. In the middle area, there is a 1 mH inductor and a 5 µF capacitor connected between the upper-middle node and the middle node; at the lower right there is also a 5 µF capacitor, whose two terminals are labeled Vc, with the positive terminal at the top and the negative terminal at the bottom, so Vc is the voltage of the middle node relative to the bottom node. Reasoning: When t→∞ reaches DC steady state, the inductor is equivalent to a short circuit, and the capacitor is equivalent to an open circuit. Thus the two 5 µF capacitors do not conduct, the two 1 mH inductors become wires, and the circuit is equivalent to a 10 V source in series with two 1 Ω resistors. The total resistance is 1 Ω + 1 Ω = 2 Ω, and the steady-state current I = 10/2 = 5 A. The voltage from the middle node where Vc is located to the bottom node is equal to the voltage drop across the lower 1 Ω resistor, therefore Vc = I × 1 Ω = 5 × 1 = 5 V.

method.method_draft: First describe the image circuit and identify the node across which Vc is measured. For t→∞ after the switch closes, replace both 1 mH inductors by wires and both 5 µF capacitors by open circuits. The circuit reduces to a 10 V source feeding two 1 Ω resistors in series. Compute the steady current as 5 A, then compute the voltage from the middle node to the bottom node as the drop across the lower 1 Ω resistor: Vc=5×1=5 V.

method.method_draft: Set the bottom rail as reference and call the Vc-positive middle node voltage v. To find the final value, take the DC limit of the element impedances/admittances: the two inductors become zero-ohm connections and the capacitors carry zero final current. method.CoT_raw:
